commits.summary: Bind the collected campaign evidence and score release pairs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Materialize 455 checksum-verified files from the collector, including its kept Jackson result, both original-side XML follow-ups, the complete control archives and the Plexus diagnosis. The guarded native route verified equality on the exact caller whose default result was incorrect. The raw 109-control repeat retained all 218 original dispositions.

Score 24 concrete release comparisons on their paired observations. Lean checked arbitrary wire records in both field orders and complete streaming partitions, without compiled Boolean reductions. Both released Lucene directions also passed the alternate layout. The 59 selected Rust test binaries and 52 selected Python test files passed. The revised rotation, doubled shift, seed extension and fold lemmas passed their capped individual checks.

Verification job 20261124-102145-certify-the-codec-signed-seed-boundary-b checks the complete 128-bit seed argument and the binding to three release JARs.
